headline: Fortinet (FTNT) Raises Revenue Outlook After Strong Q2 And New AI Product Push
summary: Fortinet raised its annual revenue forecast after reporting strong Q2 results that exceeded its prior guidance on revenue and profitability. The company highlighted progress in its shift to a subscription led model and deeper use of generative AI across its product suite. Fortinet announced a collaboration with Intel on the Fortinet Security Processor 6 and rolled out new offerings including FortiGate 1200G and FortiSOC.
